What is known about each model, precision and machine: **runs** (a result file shows it), **untested** (nobody ran it: not a promise either way) or **does not run** (a result file shows it, and why). Every number comes from the result file in its row, with the version that produced it. Prompt read is the median of the cold 4K-token prose prompt; generation is the median after a 4K-token context; the context is what one request could hold on that run; the last two columns are `ayaka bench`'s sanity checks (a forced tool call and a JSON answer, each checked against its schema).
